witness.definition: f_3(N) = max size of S ⊆ {1..N} such that no 3-element subset {a,b,c} ⊆ S has gcd(a,b) = gcd(a,c) = gcd(b,c).

run.detail: TypeError: verify() takes 0 positional arguments but 1 was given

claim: Running the verifier (exit 0) certifies by exhaustive exact-integer enumeration — stdlib gcd over every subset of {1..N} and every triple, fail-closed asserts, no floats, no filesystem/network/stream access, deterministic — that f_3(N)=1,2,2,3,3,3,3 for N=1..7, which is the entire finite content of L1; it has no asymptotic content and does not close Branch A.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
